text: This is a complete index of persons involved with wage contracts. These might involve company contracts with individuals. Here one finds the contractual details of knechts, a sort of indentured servant. There were two types of knechts, free or company knechts. Company knechts were seconded company employees who were contracted to farmers or burghers for a period of one year. The free knechts were individuals who were paid farm-hands. A few were teachers who had service conditions. The free knechts were listed in the three Eenloopendes lyste on this CD-ROM.
